## 🎯 Objective
A concise, high-level summary of what this epic achieves and why it is critical to the cluster architecture.

## 📋 Story Checklist
List the individual, actionable story issues that must be completed to close this Epic. Use GitHub issue linking (`#<issue-number>`) once the stories are created.

- [ ] #<STORY_ID> - [Title of Story 1]
- [ ] #<STORY_ID> - [Title of Story 2]
- [ ] #<STORY_ID> - [Title of Story 3]

## 🛠️ Definition of Done (DoD)
- [ ] All associated stories are completed and merged into `main`.
- [ ] Workstation pre-commit shellcheck and YAML validation gates pass cleanly.
- [ ] High-density system context compiles automatically to `active-codebase.md`.
- [ ] Architecture Reference Documents (ARDs) updated (if applicable).
